name: dangling-prior-run-implementations
description: dup-run-check inspects merge-target history only, so prior implementer passes whose run branches were never integrated are invisible: fabro-b03f was fully implemented twice before (runs 01M2XSA56XFSQPH3PAM4KXZCGY @ 32f86ae5 and 01M2Y052A16VSYQFSC46H090HE @ 7892b9c3, dangling commits reachable from no branch) and the preflight reported verdict clean, forcing a third from-scratch pass. Before reimplementing a seed, also scan git log --all --follow -- <seed-named assets> for unreachable Fabro-Run implementer commits; their diffs are recoverable design input even when the runs died pre-integration.
